intro.text: An ancient nation of Nalthis that once ruled a large empire.

description.text: In its day Chedesh dominated the world, yet it left few writings behind and has long since faded away, though its memory survives.

items.text: Chedesh explorers came upon the tropical jungle region where the Tears of Edgli grow, a land the Pahn Kahl already called home. Vo, who sailed on one of their ships, Returned off that coast, and the ship's company founded a kingdom named Hanald on the beach where T'Telir now stands.
